name: Connected native GitHub commit headers
capability: Bounded retained-only native commit and changed-file header view. Preserves actual SHA, repository/URL/date/login/ID fields and exact source paths, compares an optional requested commit identity, bounds literal message prefixes and sparse file selection, and omits diff, patch, comment, title-alias and email payloads without provider calls.
next_gap: The current projector consumes the native structuredContent.commit representation; it does not interpret raw REST or compare payloads.
